translations.web: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
translations.bsb: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
translations.kjv: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
